ops.title: Investigate recurrent long-running drive watch write amplification
ops.description: Owner /root; held behind Capt-triggered CCN matcher installation, remote EAGAIN and CCN status. Fresh native 5.008s sample at 2026-11-12 18:50 Pacific measured PID96938 Python3.14 drive watch --loop --drive durable-agents --project Iris at11.97MiB/s writes,16.8% one-core CPU. PID48101 drive dashboard v1.0.566 at42.9%CPU. Evidence answer-index-preinstall-pressure.json and fresh process_identity metadata. Next executable step: bounded native I/O trace/profile of actual drive watch writes, identify files and transaction lifecycle; determine whether this old Python watch is still required by current Go tooling without interrupting sessions.

ops.text: Ship and install a measured write-amplification fix preserving behavior and protected sessions; verify actual natural watch writes improve and no redundant whole-store rewrites.
